title: Sleepy red panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body curled up -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='72' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- lighter belly/tail area -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='76' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#E86850'/>
  <!-- tail curled around -->
  <path d='M70 78 Q85 75 82 62 Q80 55 74 58' stroke='#8E2A1F' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 78 Q85 75 82 62 Q80 55 74 58' stroke='#D94B33' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail tip -->
  <circle cx='73' cy='58' r='5' fill='#5C1A12'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='50' r='18' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M22 38 Q18 26 28 32 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <path d='M50 38 Q54 26 44 32 Z' fill='#C0392B'/>
  <path d='M23 36 Q21 30 27 33 Z' fill='#5C1A12'/>
  <path d='M49 36 Q51 30 45 33 Z' fill='#5C1A12'/>
  <!-- white face markings -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='56' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='46' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#F5E6D3'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M26 47 Q29 50 32 47' stroke='#3B1A10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 47 Q43 50 46 47' stroke='#3B1A10' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3B1A10'/>
  <!-- sleepy mouth -->
  <path d='M33 57 Q36 60 39 57' stroke='#3B1A10' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='54' r='3' fill='#E86850' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='54' r='3' fill='#E86850' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- front paw tucked under chin -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='64' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#5C1A12'/>
  <!-- other paw -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#5C1A12'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M58 30 L62 30 L58 35 L62 35' stroke='#7EC8E3' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M64 22 L67 22 L64 26 L67 26' stroke='#7EC8E3' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M70 16 L72 16 L70 19 L72 19' stroke='#7EC8E3' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
